direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; scene at least 70% of main; single non-wrapping horizontal rail of equal targets, aria-current, arrow-key movement; all targets at least 36px; condense side content inside its reserved zone
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68); emerald/neon #A8F04A primary with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D only for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; no label under 12px
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second and final logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity separate from investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens typed consent form; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, no route through offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks visible beside approved recovery plan while replacement tasks await approval
